And I know better then to get my aft shot up by pirates.|Eridan Lanclo|<ref name="HoloNetNews">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_3.html|Senate Approves Transit Tax}}</ref>}}
'''Eridan Lanclo''' was a trader during the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] voted on adding a [[transit tax|surtax]] for passengers traveling on registered starliners, Lanclo was in favor of it due to it being in favor for independent traders and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operators.<ref name="HoloNetNews" />
